description: FIND THE NAME when you do not have one, then hand it to dossier. `corpus` picks what is read.

MATCHING IS A CONJUNCTION: every whitespace-separated token must appear in ONE searchable unit, so use the two most distinctive words rather than a phrase. An empty result is GRADED and reports what it did NOT read — it claims certainty only when no corpus outside search's reach holds a match, and a multi-token miss names the token that emptied it.

READ `kind` ON EVERY ROW: it is what you pass back to dossier, verbatim. A function, variable, macro, class, struct, union or config symbol is followable; a file, typedef or enumeration row is already everything the index holds, and dossier says so rather than guessing.

INVENTORY CORPORA enumerate a layer instead of ranking against `text`. 'locks' and 'threads' ignore `text` entirely; 'files' and 'config' filter on it. READ `row_meaning` on those replies: one 'locks' row is one (name, scope, kind) identity and NOT one mutex, and 'files' counts only what THIS INDEX HOLDS rather than taking a census of the tree.
For one named lock, thread or config symbol, dossier is the shorter route; these corpora answer 'what does this repo have', not 'what is this thing'.
